"}</script>
<script>
'use strict';
const data=JSON.parse(document.getElementById('book-data').textContent),count=data.pages.length;
const $=id=>document.getElementById(id);
const stage=$('stage'),book=$('book'),viewport=$('viewport');
let single=window.innerWidth<850,current=0,busy=false,zoomed=false;
const reduce=matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)');
const indexPair=n=>single?[-1,n]:n===0?[-1,0]:[n*2-1,n*2<count?n*2:-1];
const last=()=>single?count-1:Math.floor(count/2);
const currentPage=()=>single?current:current===0?0:current*2-1;
const preload=new Map();
function loadImage(i){if(i<0||i>=count)return Promise.resolve();if(preload.has(i))return preload.get(i);const promise=new Promise(resolve=>{const im=new Image();im.onload=resolve;im.onerror=resolve;im.src=data.pages[i].image});preload.set(i,promise);return promise}
function imageAt(i){if(i<0||i>=count)return '';return '<img draggable="false" alt="Pagina '+(i+1)+'" src="'+data.pages[i].image+'">'}
function setPage(el,i){el.innerHTML=imageAt(i);el.classList.toggle('blank',i<0||i>=count)}
function classes(){stage.classList.toggle('single',single);stage.classList.toggle('cover',!single&&current===0);stage.classList.toggle('end',!single&&current===last()&&count%2===0)}
function controls(){
 const [l,r]=indexPair(current),valid=[l,r].filter(i=>i>=0);
 $('status').textContent=valid.length===2?'Pagine '+(valid[0]+1)+' e '+(valid[1]+1)+' di '+count:'Pagina '+(valid[0]+1)+' di '+count;
 $('pageInput').value=valid[0]+1;
 $('prev').disabled=$('edgePrev').disabled=busy||current===0;
 $('next').disabled=$('edgeNext').disabled=busy||current===last();
 $('mode').disabled=$('zoom').disabled=busy;
 $('mode').textContent=single?'Due pagine':'Una pagina';
 $('zoom').textContent=zoomed?'Adatta':'Ingrandisci';$('zoom').setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(zoomed));
 $('reading').textContent=valid.map(i=>data.pages[i].text).join('\n\n');
 valid.forEach(i=>{loadImage(i);loadImage(i+1);loadImage(i+2);loadImage(i-1)});
}
function render(){classes();const[l,r]=indexPair(current);setPage($('left'),l);setPage($('right'),r);controls()}
function resize(){
 const availH=Math.max(280,viewport.clientHeight-(window.innerWidth<850?48:72));
 const availableW=Math.max(250,viewport.clientWidth-(window.innerWidth<850?32:104));
 const ratio=595.276/841.89;
 const fitted=Math.min(availH,availableW/(single?1:2)/ratio,1050);
 const height=fitted*(zoomed?1.7:1);
 stage.style.setProperty('--height',height+'px');stage.style.setProperty('--width',(height*ratio)+'px');
 $('canvas').style.width=zoomed?Math.max(viewport.clientWidth,height*ratio*(single?1:2)+104)+'px':'100%';
 $('canvas').style.minHeight=Math.max(viewport.clientHeight,height+68)+'px';
}
function face(image,back=false){const d=document.createElement('div');d.className='face '+(back?'back':'front');d.innerHTML=imageAt(image);return d}
async function turnTo(target){
 target=Math.max(0,Math.min(last(),target));if(busy||target===current)return;
 busy=true;controls();const forward=target>current,[ol,or]=indexPair(current),[nl,nr]=indexPair(target);
 await Promise.all([loadImage(nl),loadImage(nr)]);
 if(reduce.matches){current=target;busy=false;render();return}
 const leaf=document.createElement('div');leaf.className='leaf '+(forward?'forward':'backward');
 if(single){
  setPage($('right'),nr);leaf.append(face(or),face(nr,true));book.append(leaf);
  const motion=leaf.animate([{transform:'rotateY(0deg)',opacity:1},{transform:'rotateY('+(forward?-88:88)+'deg)',opacity:1,offset:.65},{transform:'rotateY('+(forward?-160:160)+'deg)',opacity:0}],{duration:680,easing:'cubic-bezier(.28,.05,.24,1)',fill:'forwards'});
  await motion.finished;
 }else{
  if(forward){setPage($('left'),ol);setPage($('right'),nr);leaf.append(face(or),face(nl,true))}
  else{setPage($('left'),nl);setPage($('right'),or);leaf.append(face(ol),face(nr,true))}
  book.append(leaf);
  const was=current;current=target;classes();current=was;
  const motion=leaf.animate([{transform:'rotateY(0deg)'},{transform:'rotateY('+(forward?-180:180)+'deg)'}],{duration:850,easing:'cubic-bezier(.28,.04,.22,1)',fill:'forwards'});
  await motion.finished;
 }
 current=target;leaf.remove();busy=false;render();
}
const next=()=>turnTo(current+1),prev=()=>turnTo(current-1);
$('next').onclick=$('edgeNext').onclick=next;$('prev').onclick=$('edgePrev').onclick=prev;
function goPage(n){n=Math.max(0,Math.min(count-1,n));return turnTo(single?n:n===0?0:Math.floor((n+1)/2))}
$('jump').onsubmit=e=>{e.preventDefault();const n=Number($('pageInput').value);if(Number.isFinite(n))goPage(n-1)};
$('mode').onclick=()=>{if(busy)return;const p=currentPage();single=!single;current=single?p:p===0?0:Math.floor((p+1)/2);render();resize()};
$('zoom').onclick=()=>{zoomed=!zoomed;resize();controls();viewport.scrollTo({top:0,left:0})};
$('full').onclick=async()=>{try{if(!document.fullscreenElement)await document.documentElement.requestFullscreen();else await document.exitFullscreen()}catch{$('full').title='Schermo intero non disponibile in questa finestra'}};
$('download').href=data.pdf;
for(const chapter of data.chapters){const op=document.createElement('option');op.value=chapter.page;op.textContent=chapter.title;$('chapters').append(op)}
$('chapters').onchange=e=>{if(e.target.value!=='')goPage(Number(e.target.value)-1);e.target.value=''};
document.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(['INPUT','SELECT','TEXTAREA'].includes(document.activeElement.tagName))return;if(e.key==='ArrowRight'||e.key==='PageDown'){e.preventDefault();next()}if(e.key==='ArrowLeft'||e.key==='PageUp'){e.preventDefault();prev()}if(e.key==='Home'){e.preventDefault();turnTo(0)}if(e.key==='End'){e.preventDefault();turnTo(last())}});
let swipe=null;
book.addEventListener('touchstart',e=>{const t=e.changedTouches[0];swipe={x:t.clientX,y:t.clientY}},{passive:true});
book.addEventListener('touchend',e=>{if(!swipe)return;const t=e.changedTouches[0],dx=t.clientX-swipe.x,dy=t.clientY-swipe.y;if(Math.abs(dx)>55&&Math.abs(dx)>Math.abs(dy)*1.5){dx<0?next():prev()}swipe=null},{passive:true});
window.addEventListener('resize',resize);document.addEventListener('fullscreenchange',resize);
render();resize();loadImage(0).then(()=>$('loading').hidden=true);
</script>
</body></html>
